title: Fix media rendering fallbacks, add draft preview, restore reliable audio playback, and clarify Media button label

requirements.summary: Ensure hero, image slots, video slots, and background song render in preview/live using MediaStore state with correct fallback to backend-published media when IndexedDB is empty.
acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh load with an empty browser storage (no IndexedDB/localStorage media), the app fetches backend published media and displays: hero background (if published), any published image slots, any published video slots, and the published song (if present).
In the live/production deployment, the Hero section background and the Image/Video Memory sections visibly render the uploaded/published media without requiring a manual refresh.
If a slot is cleared in published media, the corresponding UI slot falls back to the existing placeholder media for that slot (no broken/pink/blank placeholders).

file_operations.description: Harden the media initialization/refresh flow so published media is always fetched and merged when local IndexedDB is absent, and provide a safe in-app refresh capability after publish so preview/live views update without manual reload. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure backend-published media URLs are derived consistently for hero/images/videos/song using ExternalBlob direct URLs, and make the fetch logic resilient (clear handling and empty-slot behavior) so UI reliably falls back to placeholders when published items are null. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure hero background rendering continues to fall back to the existing placeholder image whenever the MediaStore hero URL is null/cleared, across preview and production builds.
Confirm image slot rendering always falls back to configured placeholder media when a slot has no MediaStore URL (including when published media is empty or cleared).
Confirm video slot rendering always falls back to configured placeholder media when a slot has no MediaStore URL (including when published media is empty or cleared).

requirements.summary: Add a clear pre-publish draft preview inside the Media Manager showing staged Hero, Images, Videos, and Song (including order/transforms and clear placeholders).
acceptanceCriteria: Media Manager includes a clear section labeled in English (e.g., "Preview") that shows: the current draft Hero background, a grid preview of draft images in the current draft order with transforms applied, a grid preview of draft videos, and an audio preview for the draft song.
The preview reflects staged draft uploads/replacements/clears immediately after the user selects files, without requiring Submit.
When a slot is staged as 'clear' in the draft, the preview shows the placeholder/fallback for that slot (and does not continue showing an old image/video).

file_operations.description: Add an explicit English-labeled "Preview" section within the Media Manager that summarizes draft/staged values (hero, images ordered with transforms, videos, and song audio) and displays placeholders whenever a slot is staged as clear. Ensure the preview uses staged draft values immediately after selection (no submit required).

requirements.summary: Fix background audio playback reliability across preview/live (including uploaded songs) and improve behavior when autoplay is blocked on mobile browsers.
acceptanceCriteria: If autoplay is blocked, the UI provides an English call-to-action that clearly instructs the user to tap to start audio (e.g., the existing MusicPlayer play button must successfully start audible playback).
When the user uploads/replaces the background song and submits, the MusicPlayer updates to the new song and the user can play/pause it normally.

Audio playback works for supported upload types already accepted by the UI (.mp3 and .wav). If the file is not MP3, the audio element must still attempt playback (do not hardcode only audio/mpeg sources).

file_operations.description: Update MusicPlayer to avoid hardcoding only audio/mpeg sources, reliably reload/play when the song URL changes, and show an English tap-to-start call-to-action when autoplay is blocked while keeping the play button as the primary control.
Ensure the draft song preview audio control attempts playback for both .mp3 and .wav uploads and stays in sync with staged draft changes (replace/clear) before submit.

requirements.summary: Rename the Hero section Media entry-point button label to consistently read "Media" on all screen sizes while keeping the icon and accessibility label.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile and desktop, the Hero section top-right button label reads "Media" (not "Edit").
The button retains an accessible English aria-label describing what it opens (media management for hero/images/videos/song).

file_operations.description: Change the Hero section top-right button text so it always displays the English label "Media" across responsive breakpoints, keep the icon, and preserve/confirm the English aria-label.

requirements.summary: Make clear actions understandable and ensure they reliably remove media references so UI falls back to placeholders immediately after Submit and after reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Clearing a Hero/Image/Video/Song in the Media Manager draft updates the Media Manager preview immediately to show the placeholder/default for that media.
After clicking Submit, cleared items are removed from the live app view immediately (Hero/Image grid/Video grid/Song), without requiring a refresh.
After a full page reload, cleared items remain cleared (i.e., they do not reappear from stale local URLs).

file_operations.description: Improve/standardize English clear affordances and ensure clear actions update the Media Manager's preview instantly (hero/images/videos/song), never showing stale preview URLs after a draft clear.
After a successful publish, ensure the app's live MediaStore state is refreshed/applied so cleared items disappear immediately in the main view without requiring a full page reload.
Ensure MediaStore state updates and persisted storage updates fully remove cleared references (including any leftover blob URL bookkeeping) so cleared media does not reappear after reload.
